biotools.summary: COMA is an interactive resource providing insights into circadian metabolic rhythms across 16 rat anatomical structures during development. It integrates data from liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry analyses of metabolites across various developmental stages, enabling exploration of circadian metabolic regulation.
